_comment: The campaign. A linear, single-player run from a loaner marker to the Aurum Kompressor. Chapters gate on SKILL -- clear this, at this tier -- never on time played, per BUILD_PLAN's out-of-scope list.
_modes: Release campaign uses Gauntlet exclusively. Boss and Horde goals are replaced by pro clears and flawless sweeps; the final marker remains earned, never purchased.

chapters.title: Walk-On
chapters.subtitle: Everybody starts as a walk-on.
chapters.brief: Marge hands you a loaner and points at the tournament field. Twelve of them, one of you, five rounds. Nobody expects you to clear it today.
chapters.closer: That's a clear. First one's the only one that's ever a surprise.

chapters.title: Yard Sale
chapters.subtitle: Too many corners to hold.
chapters.brief: Dustline. A dead freight yard: tactical shells, jackknifed trailers and three gutted school buses, none of it square to anything else. Every container corner is a lane and you cannot pre-aim all of them.
chapters.closer: You stopped trying to watch everything. That is the entire lesson of that yard.

chapters.title: The Back Lot
chapters.subtitle: Shooting down at things that are moving.
chapters.brief: Urban. Two and three storey shells, dead cars, alleys. Everything you learned about lead on the flat is wrong the moment you are above them.
chapters.closer: Elevation changes the lead. Nobody tells you that. Now you know.

chapters.title: The Back Forty
chapters.subtitle: Where the paint takes a second to get there.
chapters.brief: Woods. Long lanes, real elevation, and brush that hides you without stopping anything. This is the map the pump exists for.
chapters.closer: Over a second of flight at the far end. You felt that. There is a valley past the treeline with a keep at each end -- Marge will tell you about it.

chapters.title: Local League
chapters.subtitle: They stopped going easy.
chapters.brief: Same four fields, amateur squads. Faster hands, actual comms, and they punish you for holding one angle.
chapters.closer: Tildy will sell you the fun stuff now. Ask her about the drone. Do not ask her about the drone.

chapters.title: Regional
chapters.subtitle: Crossfires, on purpose.
chapters.brief: Semi-pro. They set crossfires deliberately and they share contact in half a second. You do not win a straight fight here and you never will.
chapters.closer: Somebody's been asking about you. She wears a white armband and she does not talk.

chapters.title: The Marshal
chapters.subtitle: The marshal sets the standard.
chapters.brief: The marshal watches your Speedball run. Clear all five rounds against pro squads to earn her approval.
chapters.closer: A pro clear. She nods once. That is the whole ceremony.

chapters.title: Pro Circuit
chapters.subtitle: Everything, at the top.
chapters.brief: All four fields, pro squads, five rounds each. 170 ms reactions and they apply ninety-six percent of the correct lead. They are not cheating. They are just better than you were.
chapters.closer: The pro circuit is yours. Now make those clears flawless.

chapters.title: The Long Afternoon
chapters.subtitle: Every field. No marks.
chapters.brief: Clear every Gauntlet field at semi-pro or better without being marked once in each match. Every angle matters.
chapters.closer: A flawless sweep. Marge started keeping a note behind the counter.

chapters.title: Aurum
chapters.subtitle: The last thing on the shelf.
chapters.brief: There is a marker in a case behind the counter that Marge has never sold. A flawless pro Gauntlet on all four campaign fields. Then she opens the case.
chapters.closer: It is a pump. It holds twelve. It is the hardest marker on the field to use and it is made of gold, and that is the joke, and you earned it.

_theReward: The Aurum Kompressor -- 'the AK' -- is the end of the campaign and it is deliberately NOT an upgrade. It is a pump: one shot per manual cycle, a twelve-round hopper, the flattest arc in the game and the highest payout multiplier. It is a statement that you do not need the crutch, which is the only kind of ultimate reward an aim trainer can honestly offer. Read markers.json.

gauntlet._note: Always open. It is the game.

horde._note: Locked until the gauntlet is beaten at pro on every field.

captureTheFlag._note: Opens with Holdfast, which is the only map built for it.
